description: Returns one identified event in the selected wedding, with its name, type, date, time, venue, dress code and description, the ids of other events whose times overlap it, and the dress-code guide entry its dress code matches. Missing and other-wedding events return the same not-found result. Requires sign-in.

event_id.description: Identifier of an event in the selected wedding.

wedding_id.description: Identifier of a wedding the signed-in account can manage. Required when the account has multiple weddings.

name: get_my_event
title: Get My Wedding Event
